chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated to me, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to me from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Ibrahim ibn Abd al-Hamid from Abu al-Hasan, a Sheikh from our companions, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Indeed, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, created a white cock whose neck is beneath the Throne and its legs are in the depths of the seventh earth. It has a wing in the East and a wing in the West. No cock crows until this cock crows. When it crows, it flaps its two wings and then says: 'Glory be to Allah, Glory be to Allah, Glory be to Allah, the Great, by whose name one is not sworn falsely.'
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the white cock's crowing and its dhikr in Shia eschatology?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A'mal*, this hadith links the cosmic phenomenon of a primordial white cock to the theological validity of oaths, emphasizing that its glorification of Allah. The creature's crow serves as a divine signal, reinforcing the concept that Allah's name is never sworn falsely, thereby grounding legal oaths in cosmic reality. This narrative illustrates the Shia tradition of connecting eschatological signs with jurisprudential principles regarding truthfulness and divine witness.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 10. It was narrated to me by Muhammad b. al-Hassan who said it was narrated to me by Muhammad b. al-Hassan al-Saffar from Ya’qub b. Yazid from Muhammad b. Abi ’Umayr from Ibrahim b. Abdul-Hameed from Abi al-Hassan a Sheikh from our companions from Abi Ja’far (a.s.) who said:

“The Almighty Allah has created a giant white cock whose head is near the Divine throne and legs extending to the depth of seven layers of earth. One of its wings covers the entire east and another, the entire west, when open. No cock crows unless this cock does. When this cock wants to crow, it moves its wings and murmurs: Sub-h’aanallaahi Sub-h’aanallahil A’z’eemilladhee laisa kamithlihi shai. The Almighty Allah replies: A person who swears falsely by Me has no faith on Me in accordance with your saying.”
